select distinct SUBJECT_NO as id, SUBJECT_NAME as text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE 1 = 1 AND BOOKSET_ID IN ( SELECT BOOKSET_ID_TMPL FROM BOK_BOOKSET WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='BANK' )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{subjectLevel}
AND (SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')
ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT BOOKSET_ID , BOOKSET_NAME FROM BOK_BOOKSET order by BOOKSET_ID
SELECT DISTINCT BOOKSET_ID id, BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='BANK' order by BOOKSET_ID

SELECT DISTINCT a.FINPROD_ID AS id, fin.FINPROD_ABBR AS text FROM BOK_BANK_BALANCE a LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON a.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
AND (a.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR fin.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by a.FINPROD_ID
